description: This file contains the implementation of the TransactionDaoImpl class, which extends a generic DAO implementation and provides a method to query transactions associated with a specific order in the context of a sales management application.

classes.name: TransactionDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for managing Transaction entities, providing custom query methods.
